Name: Joash, King of Judah
Summary: Joash, also called Jehoash, was hidden as a baby from Athaliah's purge by his aunt Jehosheba, crowned at seven by the priest Jehoiada, and did right while Jehoiada lived, but after Jehoiada's death he turned to idolatry and was murdered by his servants.
KeyStory: Joash hidden from Athaliah, crowned by Jehoiada, and later murdered.
KeyVerses: 2 Kings 11:2; 2 Kings 12:1; 2 Kings 12:20; 2 Chronicles 22:11; 2 Chronicles 24:1; 2 Chronicles 24:2; 2 Chronicles 24:22
RelatedPeople: Jehosheba, Daughter of Jehoram; Jehoiada, High Priest; Athaliah; Zibiah, Mother of Joash; Jozachar, Son of Shimeath; Jehozabad, Son of Shomer; Jehoshabeath, Daughter of Jehoram; Jehoiada, the Priest; Zechariah, Son of Jehoiada
LifeLesson: Borrowed faith does not last: Joash was faithful under Jehoiada's guidance and fell once it was gone.
